summary: dellemc.openmanage known issues for 11.0.0: no SOCKS proxy export, no authenticated iDRAC8 shares, a BOSS-N1 false success, idrac_support_assist NFS subdirectory failures, ome_diagnostics export failure on OME 4.0.0, and same-name uplink modification.
questions: Which openmanage issues are known in Ansible 11.0.0?

answer_card.title: dellemc.openmanage known issues (11.0.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `idrac_diagnostics`: no SOCKS proxy export.
- `idrac_firmware`: no authenticated shares on iDRAC8.
- `idrac_storage_volume`: false success on BOSS-N1 when a virtual disk exists.
- `idrac_support_assist`: fails with NFS subdirectory paths.
- `ome_diagnostics`: SupportAssist export fails on OME 4.0.0.
- `ome_smart_fabric_uplink`: a duplicate name modifies the existing uplink.
